item.description: - Find Apple Silicon versions of your Intel-only apps (⇧⌘U): SiliconScope asks Homebrew, the app's own update feed and the App Store, and shows the download page or the `brew install --cask` command - CrossOver launchers for Windows programs are recognised and labelled instead of being counted as Mac apps to replace - New Log page with every scan and check, filterable by level and source - Settings: extra folders to scan, which sources to ask, check after every scan, auto-refreshing processes, appearance - A Help window with ten topics, and a complete Help menu - SiliconScope now updates itself
